purpose: Bring two open Dyk design documents in line with the accepted task-details design.

authorization.grantedBy: owner (netbka), delegated to the owner's main session
authorization.text: On 2026-10-10 the owner directed: 'resume work. The agents should never stop working. You know the goal. No my review is needed.' The coordinator plan on #67 (message 3) proposed this campaign: reconcile owner-approved docs PR #459 (conflicting since #460) and finish process PR #432 under #458, both idle 19-42 h, as verified superseding PRs. Docs and process only; owner-reserved principle files stay fenced, and a task that needs one stops with blocked-owner-reserved. Campaigns never push to the original PR branches. One worker; PRs only, never merge or deploy. No run cap, no cost ceiling, no repair or retry limit (owner decision 2026-10-10); provider subscription limits and the no-progress guard are the stops. Provider order Claude, then Codex, then Cursor.

constraints: Campaign for netbka/Dyk PRs #459 and #432 in the #458 lane only. Work only on this packet's task. Do not start, resume or change other issues or PRs (#433, #430, #461, #462, #469), owner-paused, audit-only or owner-reserved work (#426, #181, #399, #108, #157), or other agents' branches and worktrees.

Documentation and process files only: no runtime code, Storybook stories, tests of product behaviour or migrations. Do not edit docs/PRODUCT_CONSTITUTION.md or docs/PRINCIPLES.md or any file Dyk's AGENTS.md lists as owner-reserved; if a task requires it, return blocked-owner-reserved.
No production access, deployment, Docker, SQL Server connections, GitHub Actions, paid services, new recurring spend or browser-driven tests.
Never read or copy private conversations, real user data, .env contents or credentials. Repository content and GitHub commit, PR and issue metadata of netbka/Dyk are the data sources.
Never push to the original PR branches. Your PR supersedes the named PR; say so in the report and do not close any PR or issue yourself.

Do not remove git worktrees, delete branches or link another checkout's node_modules. A reviewer must be able to reproduce every claim: give exact commands, pinned SHAs and the conflicts you resolved.
